items.title: Profile-picture shadow is restrained without resizing the image
items.precondition: An isolated runtime is running; a profile-picture activity post is visible in the home feed.
steps: Open the home feed at a desktop viewport of at least 1024px wide.
Inspect the perimeter around the circular image and compare its image diameter and ring with the pre-change reference.
Repeat at a narrow mobile viewport.
items.expected: The profile image remains the same size and centered with its card ring intact. It has a subtle close shadow only; no broad blurred gray halo surrounds it, and no content overlaps or clips.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human acceptance confirmed in the browser after the final shadow adjustment. The profile image retains its original size and ring, with no broad halo visible.

items.title: Home feed uses a compact 4px card rhythm
items.precondition: An isolated runtime is running; the home feed contains at least two posts.
steps: Open the populated home feed at desktop width.
Measure or inspect the space from one post card edge to the next.
Refresh or use a loading state to inspect adjacent feed skeletons.
Repeat the populated-feed check at a narrow mobile viewport.
items.expected: Adjacent populated cards and adjacent skeleton cards use a 4px layout gap; the existing card shadows remain the only visual breathing room, without an oversized visible break. The composer-to-first-post spacing and all in-card padding remain unchanged.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human acceptance confirmed in the browser after the final 4px spacing adjustment. Adjacent feed cards read as compact while remaining distinct through their existing shadows.

items.title: Shared PostCard consumers retain their layouts
items.precondition: An isolated runtime contains a profile-picture activity post, an ordinary photo update, and standard media accessible from feed, post detail, or profile timeline.
steps: Open a profile-picture activity post from the home feed into post detail.
View a profile timeline containing an embedded post card.
Inspect an ordinary photo update and a standard image post.
items.expected: Post detail and the embedded timeline have no clipping or unintended spacing changes. Ordinary photo-update and standard-media treatments retain their existing layout and shadows.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: Human acceptance confirmed in the browser. The tested feed presentation shows no visible regression in the scoped post-card consumers.

items.title: Frontend verification gate
items.expected: No typecheck, build, or lint failure is caused by the two visual changes. Any pre-existing warning or failure is recorded with its source and is not waived silently.
items.evidence: 2026-08-07: npm run typecheck and npm run build passed after the initial implementation and both spacing refinements (Rev 4 8px, Rev 5 4px). npm --prefix frontend run lint completed with six pre-existing warnings in AuthContext.tsx, ThemeContext.tsx, MessageQuoteStrip.tsx, PostDetailPage.tsx, and PostPhotoCommentsPage.tsx; none are changed by this plan.
items.notes: No repository test script or check:conventions script is defined in package.json. The production build reports the existing Vite chunk-size advisory only.
